articles.title: The Plan: Extell’s 70-Unit 50 West 66th Street Leans Into Luxury Via Hospitality
articles.narrative: Extell Development Company's 50 West 66th Street, a 70-story luxury condominium building in New York City, is leaning into a hospitality-driven experience with its extensive amenities and high-end finishes. The project, which began resident move-ins last year, features 121 units across its 'house' and 'tower' sections, with prices ranging from $8 million to $85 million. Many buyers purchased units based on renderings, drawn by the panoramic views and resort-quality amenities, which span 50,000 square feet and include multiple pools, sports courts, and lounges.

data_points.address: 50 West 66th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Panoramic views from the Hudson River to Central Park South, luxury finishes including white marble kitchens with Miele appliances, SmallBone cabinetry, heated bathroom floors, rain showers, and deep-soaking tubs. Extensive amenities include indoor and outdoor pools, a full-size basketball court, a two-lane bowling alley, media room, children's playrooms, gaming room, gym, squash court, steam shower, and sauna.
data_points.project_notes: The building has two sections: the 'house' with 84 units and the 'tower' with 37 units. Residents began moving in last year, with some units still undergoing completion.

articles.title: Looking Past the Noise: A More Nuanced View of Multifamily
articles.narrative: This article, based on a podcast discussion, argues that the multifamily market is moving beyond broad national trends to a phase defined by local realities, operational discipline, and selective opportunities. The author emphasizes the market's resilience despite a historic supply wave, noting that national rent declines and vacancy increases have been modest. While acknowledging a 'choppy' and 'renter-favorable' environment, the piece highlights that strong absorption data contradicts some negative perceptions. The author concludes that future performance will increasingly depend on execution, asset positioning, and local market dynamics as new supply normalizes and demand proves more durable.

articles.title: Venture X Coworking Location to Open in Pompano Beach
articles.narrative: Priddy Spaces has signed a 10-year lease for 20,000 square feet to open a new Venture X coworking location in Pompano Beach, FL. The space, which will occupy three floors of a 44,102-square-foot office building, is part of Grover Corlew's Mayla Pompano mixed-use development. This expansion reflects the significant transformation and growth in Pompano Beach, driven by new residential development, improved infrastructure, and a vibrant local economy, making it an attractive location for businesses and talent.

data_points.address: 2335 East Atlantic Boulevard, Pompano Beach, FL
data_points.notable_features: The coworking outpost will feature 85 private office suites and four meeting rooms, spanning the building's second, third, and fourth floors. The office building is part of a larger mixed-use development that includes a 355-unit apartment building and two other office properties.
data_points.project_notes: The office building is within Grover Corlew’s Mayla Pompano mixed-use development.

articles.title: AI Wealth Management Platform Vise Grabs 12K SF at 50 Ninth Avenue
articles.narrative: AI wealth management platform Vise is relocating its headquarters to 50 Ninth Avenue in New York City's Meatpacking District, quadrupling its office footprint to nearly 12,000 square feet. The 10-year lease for the second-floor space, represented by Current Real Estate Advisors for the tenant and Newmark for the landlord, Tavros Capital, reflects Vise's focus on upgrading its office environment and culture. The space features high ceilings and an atrium outdoor garden, with a custom build-out planned by the owner to meet the tenant's specific needs.

data_points.address: 50 Ninth Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Space spans the second floor of combined historic townhomes, featuring over 20-foot-high pitched ceilings, an atrium outdoor garden, and dramatic vaulted ceilings with ample natural light. It is located directly across from the Apple store and above the new Delilah club.
data_points.project_notes: The landlord will build out the space to Vise's specifications. A creative solution involved a ground-floor retailer expanding upstairs to allow Vise to secure its desired space and budget.

articles.title: SME Capital Forced to Hand Over Hudson Yards Condo Building to Residents
articles.narrative: SME Capital Ventures is transferring ownership of 441 West 37th Street, a nine-unit condominium building in Hudson Yards, to its condominium board following an investigation by the New York Attorney General's office. The firm, which acquired the property out of foreclosure in 2023, failed to pay bills and address safety violations, leading to a settlement that includes a $700,000 payment and the handover of control to the homeowners. The Attorney General emphasized that private equity firms must adhere to legal responsibilities to homeowners, while SME Capital's attorney stated the firm resolved the matter to alleviate residents' suffering caused by the original developer's conduct.

data_points.address: 441 West 37th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.project_notes: Building went into foreclosure in 2023. SME Capital Ventures acquired the building out of foreclosure in 2023 but failed to report the acquisition to the state.

articles.title: Clay Development Breaks Ground on Two Industrial Buildings Totaling 552,240 SF in Brookshire, Texas
articles.narrative: Clay Development & Construction has commenced construction on two new industrial buildings, Twinwood Distribution Center IV and V, totaling 552,240 square feet within the Uplands Twinwood Business Park in Brookshire, Texas. These facilities are part of the initial 200-acre phase of the business park and are expected to be completed in the first quarter of next year. KBC Advisors has been appointed to handle the leasing for both properties.

data_points.property_name: Twinwood Distribution Center IV and V
data_points.notable_features: Buildings feature 36-foot clear heights, 69 dock-high doors, four drive-in ramps, and 2,600 square feet of office space each, with a combined 342 car parking spaces and 120 trailer parking spaces.
data_points.project_notes: These buildings are part of the 200-acre first phase of Uplands Twinwood Business Park.

articles.title: JLL Negotiates Sale of 323,949 SF Office Campus in North San Antonio
articles.narrative: JLL has brokered the sale of Union Square, a two-building office campus totaling 323,949 square feet in North San Antonio. A partnership led by SynerMark Properties and including Tryperion Holdings acquired the property from a joint venture led by Worth & Associates. The campus was approximately 95 percent leased at the time of the transaction.

data_points.notable_features: Two-building campus with one building constructed in 1986 (10 floors, 192,763 SF) and the other in 2006 (6 floors, 131,186 SF).

articles.title: BGO Acquires 299,520 SF Industrial Portfolio in Katy, Texas
articles.narrative: BGO, in partnership with Harbor Capital, has acquired the two-property Heritage West industrial portfolio in Katy, Texas. The portfolio, totaling 299,520 square feet, was fully leased at the time of sale and was completed earlier this year.

data_points.notable_features: Front-load buildings with 32- and 36-foot clear heights.

articles.title: Zenith IOS Buys 7.5-Acre Facility in Blue Mound, Texas
articles.narrative: Zenith IOS has acquired a 7.5-acre industrial outdoor storage facility in Blue Mound, a northern suburb of Fort Worth. The property includes three buildings totaling 29,300 square feet with extensive loading capabilities. This acquisition was part of a larger portfolio transaction that also involved properties in Duncanville, Texas, and Tulsa, Oklahoma.

data_points.address: 1151-1201 Cantrell Sansom Road, Blue Mound, TX
data_points.notable_features: Features 12 drive-through bays and four dock-high loading doors.

articles.title: Barry Gosin to Step Down as Newmark CEO at Year’s End
articles.narrative: Barry Gosin, who has served as CEO of Newmark Group since 1979, will step down from his role at the end of 2026. He will transition to chairman of the operating company, and a new CEO is expected to be named by his departure. Gosin's tenure saw Newmark through its sale in 2011, a spin-off from BGC Partner Inc. in 2018, and an initial public offering in 2017, alongside over 55 company acquisitions and European expansion.

articles.title: Stream Realty Partners takes on leasing duties at Cummins Station in Nashville
articles.narrative: Stream Realty Partners has been appointed as the exclusive leasing agent for Cummins Station, a 400,000-square-foot adaptive reuse office and retail property in Nashville's Urban Core. The assignment highlights the property's appeal as a creative office and retail destination, offering a blend of historic character and modern amenities. The building provides flexible office spaces and a strong amenity package, making it attractive to a diverse range of tenants seeking an urban workplace.

data_points.notable_features: Adaptive reuse property originally a rail terminal and warehouse, featuring a blend of historic character and modern design, with a conference center, fitness center under construction, and an outdoor garden area.

articles.title: Ambrose celebrates groundbreakings at Plainfield Innovation Park in Plainfield
articles.narrative: Ambrose has broken ground on Buildings I and II at Plainfield Innovation Park, a 720-acre modern business park in Plainfield, Indiana. These two speculative industrial buildings, totaling approximately 398,000 square feet, are part of a larger development that will eventually include 14 bulk industrial buildings. The project is strategically located along Interstate 70, offering excellent access to regional and national distribution networks, and is the only speculative industrial development currently under construction in the Plainfield submarket.

data_points.property_name: Plainfield Innovation Park, Buildings I & II
data_points.total_project_all_phases: 14 bulk modern industrial buildings across 720 acres
data_points.notable_features: Buildings I & II target LEED Silver certification, feature 32-foot clear heights, and are located along Interstate 70, just under five miles from Indianapolis International Airport.
data_points.project_notes: The groundbreaking follows a $138 million investment by Boston Scientific Corporation for a 500,000-square-foot facility within the park.

articles.title: One Cardinal Way wins Large Community of the Year award
articles.narrative: One Cardinal Way, a luxury apartment community in St. Louis, was honored with the Large Community of the Year award by the National Apartment Association at its 2026 Excellence Awards. The 29-story, 297-unit tower, a 50/50 partnership between the St. Louis Cardinals and The Cordish Companies, has maintained high occupancy since its 2020 opening. The award recognizes the property's unique residential experience, which offers residents direct views into Busch Stadium and exclusive access to Cardinals gameday events, along with extensive amenities within the Ballpark Village development.

data_points.notable_features: Luxury apartment community with infinity-edge pool and sundeck offering direct views into Busch Stadium, coworking spaces, club room, and personalized concierge services. Located within Ballpark Village, offering access to dining, entertainment, and nightlife.
data_points.project_notes: Developed as a 50/50 partnership between the St. Louis Cardinals and The Cordish Companies.

articles.title: Resolute Structured Capital arranges acquisition financing for 240,000-square-foot Chicago-area manufacturing HQ
articles.narrative: Resolute Structured Capital arranged acquisition financing for MAG Capital Partners' purchase of a 240,000-square-foot manufacturing and headquarters facility in Chicago Heights, Illinois. The loan, provided by a national bank, covered 75% of the acquisition's loan-to-value. The property serves as the headquarters for Applied Acoustics International, a Tier 1 supplier to the North American automotive industry.

data_points.notable_features: Property includes on-site rail access and serves as a manufacturing facility and headquarters.
data_points.project_notes: Acquisition financing was arranged at 75% loan-to-value.

articles.title: A Record Rent, a Demand Reversal and a New Model for the West Side: Chicago industrial at mid-year
articles.narrative: Chicago's industrial market achieved a record average asking net rent of over $8 per square foot in Q2 2026, with robust first-half leasing activity totaling 25 million square feet. While the market is healthy, a notable shift has occurred where small-bay infill product has lagged behind big-box absorption, driven by major retailers and third-party logistics firms. Class A industrial properties continue to see rent increases due to tenant demand for quality and functionality, while Class B and C rents have plateaued or decreased. Developers are increasingly focusing on community benefits, such as job creation, green space, and clean energy, to secure entitlements and financing for urban infill projects. The market is also seeing a rise in sale-leaseback transactions as corporate owners seek to unlock capital from appreciated real estate assets, with strong buyer demand compressing single-tenant net lease cap rates.

articles.title: Newmark Closes Note Sale on San Pedro Adaptive Reuse
articles.narrative: Newmark arranged the sale of a note secured by Topaz Tower, a 12-story office building in San Pedro, CA, which is fully entitled for conversion into 246 market-rate multifamily units. The buyer, a private Los Angeles-based residential developer, acquired the note, gaining control of a significant adaptive reuse opportunity. The project offers an immediate execution path for a coastal high-rise multifamily conversion with ocean views in a rapidly evolving submarket.

data_points.notable_features: Fully entitled for conversion to market-rate multifamily units, includes a rooftop deck with a resort-style pool, ocean-view units, balconies, and high ceilings.
data_points.project_notes: The transaction involved the sale of a note secured by the property, rather than a direct property sale.

articles.title: Domain Lines Up $176M Financing for Mixed-Income Astoria Rentals
articles.narrative: The Domain Companies has secured $175.6 million in financing from Wells Fargo for Elara, a new mixed-income residential development in Astoria, Queens. The project will feature 429 apartments across two buildings, with 107 units designated as permanently affordable. Equity partners for the development include Canyon Partners Real Estate and BLDG Management, with JLL Capital Markets brokering the financing. The development aims to provide a high-quality living experience while reflecting the neighborhood's character.

data_points.address: 35-45, 35-33 and 35-42 41st St., New York City, NY
data_points.completion: Elara West: February 2028, Elara East: September 2028
data_points.notable_features: Mixed-income housing project with 107 permanently affordable homes.
data_points.project_notes: Comprises two buildings: Elara East (18 stories, 330 apartments) and Elara West (12 stories, 99 apartments).

articles.title: La La Land Cafe Signs with Brixton Capital for First San Diego Location
articles.narrative: La La Land Cafe has signed a lease with Brixton Capital for its first San Diego location, taking 1,168 square feet of interior space with additional terrace seating at the Del Mar Plaza retail destination. This marks a significant expansion for the dynamic brand, which has grown rapidly since its founding in 2019, and is expected to become a popular social hub.

data_points.address: 1555 Camino Del Mar, San Diego, CA
data_points.notable_features: Mezzanine terrace and café space with additional sitting and queueing space extending onto the terrace deck.
data_points.project_notes: Space formerly occupied by Pacifica Breeze Café.

articles.title: JLL Arranges Sale of Two Twin Cities Seniors Housing Properties
articles.narrative: JLL's Seniors Housing Capital Markets team facilitated the sale of a two-property seniors housing portfolio, Boulder Ponds Senior Living and Round Lake Senior Living, totaling 216 units in the Twin Cities area of Minnesota. Trident Development sold the assets to LTC Properties, Inc., with Lifespark continuing as the operator. The communities offer a range of services including independent living, assisted living, and memory care.

data_points.property_name: Boulder Ponds Senior Living and Round Lake Senior Living
data_points.notable_features: Both communities offer independent living, assisted living, and memory care services. Boulder Ponds Senior Living, completed in 2020, is a 95-unit community with approximately 98% occupancy. Round Lake Senior Living, opened in 2023, is a 121-unit community with convenient access to major employment centers, retail amenities, and healthcare services.

articles.title: Texas Pauses Data Center Power Connections, Which Could Speed Up Rapid Development
articles.narrative: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has implemented a temporary pause on new power connections for data centers, a move intended to address the escalating power demands from the rapidly expanding data center industry. This policy is expected to favor larger, more established data center developers who already have existing infrastructure and connections, potentially accelerating their development timelines by reducing competition for grid access. The pause underscores the state's effort to manage energy resources more effectively amidst significant industrial growth.

articles.title: Behring Planning A Data Center In Downtown Oakland
articles.narrative: Behring Cos. is developing a 20-megawatt artificial intelligence data center in downtown Oakland, converting an existing facility. This project aims to significantly boost the East Bay Area's AI infrastructure, supporting the growing demand for high-performance computing resources.

articles.title: KHP Sells West Hollywood Kimpton To Japanese Hotel Company For $63M
articles.narrative: KHP Capital Partners has sold the Kimpton La Peer West Hollywood hotel to Tokyo-based APA Group for $63 million. This acquisition marks a strategic move for APA Group as it seeks to expand its international portfolio.

data_points.address: 627 N La Peer Dr, West Hollywood, CA

articles.title: Pied-À-Terre Tax Won't Deter Buyers Long Term, Developers Say
articles.narrative: New York City's recently implemented pied-à-terre tax has caused some initial shifts in the luxury residential market, but developers anticipate that the market will ultimately adapt to the new levy. While there may be short-term adjustments in buyer behavior, the long-term appeal of the city's real estate is expected to remain strong, leading to market stabilization.

articles.title: How Officials Are Picking Which Parts Of Philly Will Benefit From Opportunity Zones 2.0
articles.narrative: Pennsylvania officials are in the process of selecting 217 census tracts across the state for the Opportunity Zones 2.0 program, with a submission deadline of September 28. Philadelphia is expected to have fewer designated tracts in this iteration compared to the initial Opportunity Zones program. The selection process aims to identify areas that will most benefit from the program's investment incentives.
